experience.title: Software Development Engineer
achievements: Built and led backend systems for Even Infinite's Hospital Pass, simplifying hospital-service access and driving a 65%+ increase in user engagement.

Designed and built an AI calling framework integrating LLMs into clinical workflows, enabling automated report summarization, smart care-manager suggestions, and fully automated follow-up calls—reducing manual effort by ~40%.
Built a generalized onboarding package for new insurance providers and automated CI/CD pipelines, cutting integration time from 6 weeks to 2 weeks.
Resolved 900+ weekly document re-upload failures, unblocking reliable generation of 300+ post-hospitalization forms per week across care manager workflows.
Refactored core frontend modules to enable true parallel data loading, reducing render times by ~25% and improving stability on high-traffic screens.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
achievements: Automated vehicle onboarding using plate-detection and dynamic flow control (15-screen engine); reduced manual effort 60% and onboarding errors 80%.
Rolled out a redesigned ticketing workflow for delayed orders; boosted customer satisfaction and reduced cancellations by 80%.
Migrated internal maps to Google Maps, lowering operating costs by 25% across logistics tooling.
Automated syncing of ~1M tickets with a Python-based pipeline, removing 95% of manual ops work for the team.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
achievements: Migrated 200+ legacy JS components to TypeScript + Redux within a Next.js monorepo; reduced build-time errors 40% and improved dev velocity 30%.
Built a production-safe Go streaming SDK to pipe multi-GB ZIP archives directly into S3; cut transfer latency 65% and halved memory usage.
Developed a GPS ingestion service handling ~50k messages/s with live dashboards; improved ETA prediction accuracy by 12%.
Refactored RPC and service-to-service communication with goroutines and gRPC batching; slashed P95 latency by 95% at 2k TPS.

experience.title: Backend Developer Intern
achievements: Scaled a Strapi-based ERM platform to support ~1k RPS by adding in-memory caching, optimizing SQL queries, and restructuring backend routes.
Automated hosting and deployment setup with Nginx, Certbot, and reusable scripts.

experience.title: Full-Stack Web Developer Intern
achievements: Developed backend and dashboard flows for a Next.js platform used by the UP Commercial Tax Department with automated PDF-based discrepancy tax report generation, reducing manual effort by 60%.
Implemented WAF protections, API validation, and access-control improvements for sensitive government-facing workflows.
